senses.gloss: (b. h.) to blow, blow up; פ׳ נפש to blow the soul out, to dishearten.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>מה אני הולך אצלו לָפוּחַ את נפשו</he> why should I go to him (Balak) to dishearten him?; Tanḥ. Balak 13.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:30">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ</cite> top <he>שתפוח הכרית</he>, read: <he>שתפרח</he>, v. <cite ref="K01178"><he>כְּרִית</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Shabbat 49a">Sabb. 49ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 130a:15">130ᵃ</cite> <he>שלא יָפִיחַ בהן</he> that he will not desecrate the T’fillin by passing winds.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17a">Ab. Zar. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>חֵפִיחָה</he> she broke &c.; a. e.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 3:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. III</cite> <he>אל תָּפִיחוּ את הישן</he> do not stir up that which slumbers (do not disturb the accepted order of the psalms); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 624">Yalk. ib. 624</cite> (not <he>תפיחי</he>).

senses.gloss: (denom. of פִּיחַ) [to use powdered colors,] to paint.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 60b:8">B. Bath. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>ואין מְפַיְּיחִין</he>, v. <cite ref="K00617"><he>כִּיר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 2:17">Tosef. ib. II, 17</cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְפוּיָּיח</he>; f. <he>מְפוּיֶּיחֶת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:16">Tosef. Ter. VII, 16</cite> <he>מפויה</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>מפויית</he>; <he>מצויר</he>) read <he>מְפוּיָּח</he> or <he>מְפוּיָּיח</he>.
